definitions.explanation: Work that is only available during certain times of the year, such as farming during harvest, tourism-related jobs in summer or winter resorts, or winter construction in snow regions. Often contrasted with year-round permanent employment.

examples.japanese: {季節労働|きせつろうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦スキー→スキー：03849_sukii⟧{場|じょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{季節労働|きせつろうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During winter, he does seasonal work at a ski resort.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農業|のうぎょう}→農業：01491_nougyou⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節労働|きせつろうどう}{者|しゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: In farming regions, many seasonal workers gather during harvest time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{出稼|でかせ}ぎ→出稼ぎ：14879_dekasegi⟧や{季節労働|きせつろうどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だった。
examples.english: In Hokkaido, because work decreased in winter, migrant work and seasonal labor were common.

notes:
Work that follows the rhythm of the seasons, rather than being year-round. Literally ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (season) + ⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧ (labor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節労働|きせつろうどう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従事|じゅうじ}→従事：12562_juuji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to engage in seasonal labor
- {季節労働|きせつろうどう}{者|しゃ}: seasonal worker
- {季節労働|きせつろうどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧: seasonal job openings
- ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節労働|きせつろうどう}: summer seasonal work

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{出稼|でかせ}ぎ→出稼ぎ：14879_dekasegi⟧: working away from home (often seasonal migrant labor)
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧⟦{雇用|こよう}→雇用：04840_koyou⟧: temporary employment
- ⟦{日雇|ひやと}い→日雇い：14965_hiyatoi⟧: day labor; being hired by the day
- {常用|じょうよう}⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧: regular (year-round) employment — the opposite concept
- ⟦{農閑期|のうかんき}→農閑期：25613_noukanki⟧: farming off-season

CULTURAL NOTE:
Historically in Japan, many farmers from snowy regions like ⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧ and ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧ would travel to cities or to warmer regions for {季節労働|きせつろうどう} during the winter when farm work was impossible. This practice is known as ⟦{出稼|でかせ}ぎ→出稼ぎ：14879_dekasegi⟧. In modern times, seasonal labor is common in tourism (ski resorts in winter, beach resorts in summer) and agriculture.
